plugins.name: Advanced Achievements
plugins.tagline: Create configurable milestones for building, exploration, combat, crafting, and more.
plugins.description: Advanced Achievements helps server owners reward player progress with configurable milestones, persistent stats, and flexible reward actions.
features: Configurable achievement milestones for building, exploration, combat, and crafting.
Persistent player progress backed by the plugin’s own data storage.
Reward actions for items, commands, titles, experience, and economy-style outputs.
Flexible command-based management for adding, resetting, and checking progress.
A plugin-wide profile designed for server-owned progression systems.

plugins.name: Area Rewind
plugins.tagline: Protect important builds with named areas and versioned block-state snapshots.
plugins.description: Area Rewind gives server admins a focused area-protection and restoration workflow for preserving builds, comparing states, and rolling back by region.
features: Named regions with snapshot-based rollback for individual builds and structures.
Versioned restore workflows for comparing and selecting prior state snapshots.
Aid for protection, rollback, and large-world recovery tasks.
A practical admin workflow for preserving builds before big changes.
Useful for server events, map customizations, and base recovery work.

plugins.name: Blockfolk
plugins.tagline: Create persistent fake-player NPCs without editing data files by hand.
plugins.description: Blockfolk is a persistent NPC framework for creating interactive fake-player characters with routes, behavior, inventory, chat, and item interactions.
features: Persistent fake-player NPCs that can retain their configuration across restarts.
Built-in behavior systems for routes, idle actions, and item interactions.
Inventory and container workflows that make NPCs feel active in a server economy.
Editor-style creation flows for setting up an NPC’s personality and actions.
A flexible tool for roleplay, world-building, and custom server content.

plugins.name: Blood Moon
plugins.tagline: Turn selected nights into high-pressure server events with seven distinct NPC encounters.
plugins.description: Blood Moon creates tense, themed nighttime events with custom encounters, hostile spawns, and gameplay pressure built around special event nights.
features: Special event nights that can be scheduled or triggered on demand.
Multiple encounter archetypes with distinct effects and pressure patterns.
NPC and mob-based event design to keep server nights unpredictable.
Configurable event timing and behavior for server owners.
Fits PvE, survival, or antagonist-themed progression setups.

plugins.name: Custom Jukebox
plugins.tagline: Play Note Block Studio songs through signs, redstone, or a personal music browser.
plugins.description: Custom Jukebox adds a music-focused extension for playing NBS songs via signs, redstone triggers, and in-server music controls.
features: Music playback from Note Block Studio files using plugin-managed jukebox behavior.
Sign-based controls and redstone-triggered playback options.
A browser-like interface for selecting and managing tunes.
Persistent song records and simple configuration for arena or town setups.
Helpful for decorative server music and themed gameplay spaces.

plugins.name: Hookshot
plugins.tagline: Turn ordinary fishing rods into configurable grappling hooks for exploration and mobility.
plugins.description: Hookshot transforms fishing rods into flexible grappling tools, offering a configurable mobility system for parkour, builds, faster travel, and custom movement settings.
features: Configurable grappling behavior for fishing rods and movement tools.
Support for exploration, travel, parkour, and custom movement builds.
Targeted hooking for blocks or nearby entities depending on configuration.
A set of technical movement options for server-specific gameplay styles.
Designed around practical parkour and traversal additions.

plugins.name: Map Revealer
plugins.tagline: Fill held maps from terrain or keep complete item-frame map walls synchronized automatically.
plugins.description: Map Revealer lets players reveal map data from a world or keep item-frame arrays updated with a consistent theme and passable map refresh workflow.
features: Reveal map data from the surrounding world in a held map.
Keep item-frame map walls refreshed and synchronized without constant manual updates.
Theme support and map formatting options for custom world displays.
A practical tool for map-based build showcases and custom exploration features.
Works well for display maps, base features, and map-driven server systems.

plugins.name: NPC PickUp
plugins.tagline: Bring Citizens NPCs to life with intelligent item pickup and thief mechanics.
plugins.description: NPC PickUp adds NPC-based item collection and theft behavior, helping servers create more believable citizen and world-interaction systems.
features: NPC item pickup behaviors for citizens-based roleplay or world simulation.
Theft-style or stealth interactions for more dynamic NPC scenes.
A focus on interactive world behavior without heavy infrastructure requirements.
Useful for city, town, and simulation-themed servers.
A lightweight addition to the Citizens ecosystem.

plugins.name: Piston Crusher
plugins.tagline: Turn a simple piston line into a configurable block crusher for farms and processing builds.
plugins.description: Piston Crusher adds configurable block-crushing automation that turns a piston-based setup into a compact resource processor for farms and setups that need more output from a small footprint.
features: Configurable crusher targets and processing rules for piston-based setups.
A compact solution for block-farming and resource processing.
Material filtering and adjustable output behaviors for custom farms.
Practical for compact processing lines and pack-focused automation.
Works well in survival or custom-minigame server designs.

plugins.name: Power Mining
plugins.tagline: Expand survival mining with mounted excavation and a focused collection of utility equipment.
plugins.description: Power Mining adds mining utilities such as ore-scanning behavior, mining gear, magnets, extraction tools, and equipment-based travel helpers for faster, more structured mining.
features: Mining-oriented tools for ore scanning, traversal, and utility support.
Equipment-based functionality for a more active mining workflow.
Flexible utility behavior that supplements survival mining and exploration.
Systems designed around faster ore discovery and safer extraction routes.
A broad utility plugin for dedicated mining-focused systems.

plugins.name: Rail Boost
plugins.tagline: Make minecart travel faster, steadier, and more useful for passengers and item transport.
plugins.description: Rail Boost upgrades minecart travel with speed presets, shared storage, magnetism options, and smoother rail-based transport behavior for players and items.
features: Minecart speed presets and tuned rail travel behavior.
Transport enhancements that improve comfort and control for regular players.
Optional features such as magnetic carts, pickup, and feedback systems.
Useful for quick movement, logistics, and rail-based automation builds.
An adaptable rail utility for transport-heavy servers.

plugins.name: Super Enchantments
plugins.tagline: Apply vanilla enchantments beyond their normal limits and add new combat and utility abilities.
plugins.description: Super Enchantments extends the vanilla enchantment system with raised caps, custom enchantments, and configurable combat or utility abilities for advanced gear setups.
features: Apply vanilla enchantments beyond normal caps using expanded-level controls.
Custom enchantments for combat, mobility, utility, and effects.
Context-aware enchantment selection and configuration for players and server owners.
Configurable cooldowns, effects, and item compatibility behavior.
A powerful utility for high-tier gear progression and PvP or PvE balance.

plugins.name: Useful Autocrafter
plugins.tagline: Keep automated recipes primed by reserving the final ingredient in every active Crafter slot.
plugins.description: Useful Autocrafter is a Paper-focused automation helper that prevents recipe stalls by preserving the last ingredient in active crafter slots.
features: Keeps a one-item reserve in active crafter recipe slots.
Prevents hoppers and automation from stripping crafting ingredients away.
Works with recipe-based automation while keeping crafted output flowing.
A focused Paper-only inventory automation utility.
Helpful for compact redstone and production line designs.

plugins.name: Wireless Redstone
plugins.tagline: Link copper bulbs, redstone lamps, and supported containers without physical redstone wiring.
plugins.description: Wireless Redstone links block states and container inventory workflows through named groups, making it easier to manage distance-based redstone and storage logistics.
features: Wireless connections between bulbs, lamps, and compatible blocks.
Named group-based linking for redstone and shared inventory behavior.
Distance-friendly logic for compact or large-scale builds.
Practical for industrial builds, logic rooms, and server infrastructure.
A strong fit for redstone-heavy server setups and map creators.
